name: customer-edit-01
title: Customer edit form
description: A controlled customer form with validation, submitting, recoverable errors, permission denial and unsaved-change confirmation. Pair with admin-customers-01.
docs: Supply value, savedValue, onValueChange, onSave and onCancel. Set submitting synchronously; persist on the server, handle rejection, then update savedValue and success. Protect navigation outside this form and remount by record id when switching customers.

loading.how: status="loading" disables fields and announces loading.

empty.transition: No transition owned by this block.

no-results.transition: No transition owned by this block.

error.how: status="error" announces failure while preserving controlled input.
error.transition: Retry Save; consumer clears server errors and sets submitting.

success.transition: Editing makes the form dirty again; consumer sets idle.

submitting.how: status="submitting" locks fields, Save and Cancel.
submitting.transition: Consumer resolves to success, error or permission-denied; prevent duplicate requests.

validation-error.how: Submit a blank name or malformed email; first invalid field receives focus. fieldErrors accepts server validation.
validation-error.transition: Editing clears local field errors; consumer clears stale server errors.

permission-denied.transition: Consumer rechecks permission, preserving the draft.

unsaved-changes.how: value differs from savedValue; Cancel asks whether to discard.
unsaved-changes.transition: Keep editing restores Cancel focus; Discard invokes onCancel.

offline.how: Use status="error" and custom copy; draft stays controlled.
offline.transition: Consumer owns connectivity and retry; no offline persistence.

partial.transition: No transition owned by this block.

content.sample: The customer could not be saved. Your changes are still here. Try again.

actions.name: change
actions.responsibility: Update controlled value and clear stale server errors.

actions.name: save
actions.responsibility: Set submitting synchronously, authorize/persist on server, handle rejection and update savedValue only on success.

actions.name: cancel
actions.responsibility: Close the editor and restore focus to its opener after confirmation.

responsive.strategy: Single-column fields and wrapping actions within a max-width card.

consumer: Own value, savedValue, status and server persistence. Never treat a local validation pass as server authorization.
Set submitting synchronously and keep it until the request settles; do not optimistically close a failed form.
Protect external navigation and record switches against unsaved changes. Remount the form with a record key.
Restore focus when opening/closing the editor. Clear server field errors when the affected value changes.
